headline: ttb analytics warns an AI bubble burst would hit Thailand's financial markets
body: On November 9, ttb analytics said MPI rebasing automatically upgraded Thailand's baseline 2026 growth projection from 2.4 percent to 2.7 percent. It also warned that growth is heavily concentrated in AI-linked electronics, and that in a bubble burst the impact on Thailand will be immediate and pronounced, especially in financial markets.
note: According to ttb analytics, about 76,000 registered corporate entities show characteristics of zombie SMEs. For Thai banks, that SME side may matter as much as the AI cycle.

evidence.text: Speaking at a media briefing on Monday, 9 November 2026, Dr Naris Sathapholdeja , head of TMB Data and ttb analytics at TMBThanachart Bank (ttb), presented an upgraded economic outlook while calling for urgent structural reforms to ensure sustainable growth.

By resolving long-standing discrepancies between booming export values and previously contracting manufacturing indicators, the MPI rebasing automatically upgraded Thailand's baseline GDP growth projection from 2.4 percent to 2.7 percent for 2026.
Growth is heavily concentrated in AI-linked electronics.

If the global AI boom experiences a bubble burst, the impact on Thailand will be immediate and pronounced—especially within financial markets—because we are formally indexed as a key upstream and downstream supplier.

According to ttb analytics, approximately 76,000 registered corporate entities—representing 16 percent of active Thai companies—are exhibiting characteristics of "zombie SMEs", suffering from stagnant revenues and operating profits insufficient to service debt.
